sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "hall_of_fame"."votedby" AS g, AVG("hall_of_fame"."votes") AS m1, AVG((CAST(("hall_of_fame"."ballots" - "hall_of_fame"."needed") AS REAL) / "hall_of_fame"."needed")) AS m2 FROM "hall_of_fame"  GROUP BY "hall_of_fame"."votedby"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL
quantities: hall_of_fame.relative difference of ballots cast from votes needed for election
why: average of votes received per hall_of_fame.votedby
(ballots cast - votes needed for election) / votes needed for election: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of ballots cast from votes needed for election per hall_of_fame.votedby
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of ballots cast from votes needed for election (all level)

sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "fielding_postseason"."player_id" AS e, SUM(("fielding_postseason"."dp" - "fielding_postseason"."po")) AS m1, AVG((CAST(("fielding_postseason"."gs" - "fielding_postseason"."g") AS REAL) / "fielding_postseason"."g")) AS m2 FROM "fielding_postseason" GROUP BY "fielding_postseason"."player_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT AVG("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, ("s1"."m2" - "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL WHERE "s1"."m2" > "s2"."v" ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: fielding_postseason.relative difference of games started from games at position
why: double plays - putouts: both in count and of the same kind (flows) on the same player fielding line per round and position
total of double plays minus putouts per player (by player_id) (additive)
(games started - games at position) / games at position: the relative difference of two quantities in count
average of relative difference of games started from games at position per player (by player_id)
gap to the all average of average of relative difference of games started from games at position (all level)
